description: Composite texture figure consisting of two dashed-outlined rows of inverse pole figure (IPF) triangles, (a) labelled "RT" (room temperature) and (b) labelled "LNT" (liquid nitrogen temperature), for the Fe35Mn6Al0.1C low-carbon low-density cryogenic steel. Each row contains four [001]-[101]-[111] IPF triangles whose corners are labelled 001 (bottom-left), 101 (bottom-right) and 111 (top), contoured in a blue-green-yellow-red scale with an individual colour bar printed as "Max=..." plus numeric ticks. Row (a) RT triangles are labelled with tensile strains 0 %, 3 %, 28 % and 44 %, with printed maxima Max = 2.55, 2.74, 3.16 and 4.81. Row (b) LNT triangles are labelled 3 %, 10 %, 28 % and 55 %, with Max = 2.01, 2.42, 2.57 and 6.68. In all triangles a high-intensity red maximum concentrates near the 111 corner while the 001-101 region stays low (blue). As strain increases the red 111 maximum expands and the printed maximum rises in both rows, and the LNT row reaches the largest value in the figure (Max = 6.68 at 55 %). The figure demonstrates that deformation, and particularly cryogenic deformation, sharpens a <111>-type texture with progressively higher intensity.

observations.observation: The figure is a two-row composite of inverse pole figure (IPF) triangles, the top row labelled "(a) RT" and the bottom row labelled "(b) LNT".
Every IPF triangle carries the corner labels 001 (bottom-left), 101 (bottom-right) and 111 (top).
Row (a) RT is annotated with strains 0 %, 3 %, 28 % and 44 %, and the colour bars are printed Max=2.55, Max=2.74, Max=3.16 and Max=4.81 respectively.
Row (b) LNT is annotated with strains 3 %, 10 %, 28 % and 55 %, with printed colour-bar maxima Max=2.01, Max=2.42, Max=2.57 and Max=6.68.
The highest texture intensity in every triangle is localised near the 111 corner, while the 001-101 edge region shows the lowest (blue) values.
In the RT row the printed maximum increases monotonically with strain from Max=2.55 at 0 % to Max=4.81 at 44 %.
The largest value printed anywhere in the figure is Max=6.68 for the LNT 55 % triangle, exceeding the RT 44 % value of 4.81 at comparable high strain.
A red high-intensity spot near 111 is already visible in the LNT 3 % triangle (Max=2.01), i.e. at low strain in the cryogenic condition.
The colour bars are discrete blue-green-yellow-red scales with numeric ticks; for Max=4.81 the ticks read 1, 2, 3, 4 and for Max=6.68 they read 2, 4, 6.
No legend naming the mapped quantity (e.g. multiples of random) or the step size is printed inside the figure; only the "Max=" values are given.
The RT 0 % triangle is the only untested/undeformed condition shown and displays the flattest, most diffuse intensity distribution of the eight panels.

subfigures.description: IPF triangle for the RT sample at 0 % strain; diffuse green contouring with blue-patched low-intensity 001-101 region and printed colour-bar Max=2.55.
RT, 3 % strain IPF triangle; green field with a developing high-intensity region near the 111 corner, Max=2.74.
RT, 28 % strain IPF triangle; a clear red band/apex developed at the 111 corner, deeper blue elsewhere, Max=3.16.
RT, 44 % strain IPF triangle; strong red maximum at 111 with large deep-blue 001-101 region, Max=4.81.
LNT, 3 % strain IPF triangle; a small red high-intensity spot already present near 111, Max=2.01.
LNT, 10 % strain IPF triangle; green contours with intensified region near 111, Max=2.42.
LNT, 28 % strain IPF triangle; pronounced red maximum at the 111 corner, Max=2.57.
LNT, 55 % strain IPF triangle; brightest red apex at 111 over a mostly deep-blue triangle, highest printed value in the figure Max=6.68.

unreadable_items: No caption was supplied with this figure, so the measured quantity of the colour scale (e.g. multiples of random) and the EBSD step size are not stated
Small numeric tick labels on the Max=2.55 and Max=2.74 colour bars are only partially legible at the supplied resolution
